tour.title: Project Overview & Architecture
tour.description: Start with README.md to understand the system overview. This project is a multi-platform coffee shop management system featuring a desktop app (Java Swing) and a web platform (Spring Boot & Next.js), sharing a unified MySQL database.

tour.title: Database Initialization Schema
tour.description: The database schema forms the foundation of the shared data model. These SQL scripts define the tables, indexes, and initial data values used by both the Swing desktop app and the Spring Boot backend server.
tour.languageLesson: SQL scripts for initial tables setup should define clear foreign key constraints and primary keys to establish relation boundaries. Placing indexes on frequently queried fields like codes or status columns improves lookup performance.

tour.title: Desktop App Entry Point
tour.description: The main entry point for the desktop client application. It configures the look-and-feel using the modern FlatLaf theme, establishes database connection parameters, and opens the main application window.

tour.title: Desktop UI Panels & Dashboards
tour.description: These classes implement the core desktop window and the dashboard visualization. They coordinate navigation between side tabs (sales, purchases, inventory) and render responsive FlatLaf metrics cards.

tour.title: Web Backend REST API Entry
tour.description: The entry point and configuration for the web backend API. Spring Boot initializes the application context, scans components, and exposes the REST API layer on port 8080.

tour.title: Separation of Concerns via DTOs
tour.description: This step demonstrates the separation of architectural layers. Controllers accept and return Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) rather than direct persistent models, shielding backend persistence details from frontend clients.
tour.languageLesson: The DTO pattern decouples the database schema from the API contract. Writing manual static mapping methods (such as fromEntity and toEntity) keeps mapping logic transparent and avoids runtime dependencies on mapping libraries.

tour.title: Web Frontend Shell & UI pages
tour.description: The entry point of the Next.js web application frontend. It sets up the root layout with the Google Font Inter, wraps the children with responsive styling, and renders the premium Glassmorphism homepage.

tour.title: Containerized Services Orchestration
tour.description: The container deployment configuration. It defines and sets up the MySQL 8.0 database container service, establishing connection networks and mounting initial SQL schema scripts automatically.
tour.languageLesson: Docker Compose allows running multi-container applications easily. Specifying networks isolates database containers from public access while allowing in-network applications (desktop/backend) to connect securely.
